title: Customers per city
statementMd:
Count customers in each city.

Expected columns: `city`, `customers`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY city;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
